name: Medazepam
aliases: nobrium, azepamid, rudotel, raporan, mezapam, talis
summary: The drug is a benzodiazepine derivative and is described to have similar effects as diazepam. The drug is reportedly long-acting with a half-life of 36-200 hours. The drug is rarely prescribed and is a prodrug to diazepam. The drug has been described by anectodal reports as a sort of '/Desoxy-Diazepam/'.

pharmacology.text: Medazepam acts as a prodrug to nordazepam. Benzodiazepine drugs including medazepam increase the inhibitory processes in the cerebral cortex by allosteric modulation of the GABA receptor. Benzodiazepines may also act via micromolar benzodiazepine-binding sites as Ca2+ channel blockers and significantly inhibited depolarization-sensitive calcium uptake in experiments with cell components from rat brains.

summaryZh: 美達西泮（英語：Medazepam）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式為C16H15N2，屬於一種長效苯二氮䓬類藥物，體內半衰期為36–200小時。

uses.en: It is prescribed in some countries for anxiety and tension, though it is now rarely used.
uses.zh: 在部分國家它被開立用於焦慮與緊張，不過現在已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 在部分国家它被开立用于焦虑与紧张，不过现在已很少使用。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, muscle relaxation, poor coordination, memory loss and confusion. Like other benzodiazepines, regular use can lead to dependence, and stopping suddenly after regular use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures. Too much can dangerously slow breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它會引起嗜睡、肌肉放鬆、協調變差、失憶與混亂。和其他苯二氮平類一樣，經常使用可能導致依賴，長期使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷，包括癲癇發作。過量可能使呼吸危險地減慢。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会引起嗜睡、肌肉放松、协调制差、失忆与混乱。和其他苯二氮平类一样，经常使用可能导致依赖，长期使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断，包括癫痫发作。过量可能使呼吸危险地减慢。

fact.en: Medazepam is a benzodiazepine missing the usual carbonyl oxygen, and the body converts it into diazepam and nordazepam, which carry much of its effect.
fact.zh: 美達西泮是一種缺少一般羰基氧的苯二氮平類，在體內會轉換成地西泮與去甲西泮，它的作用大多由這兩者發揮。
fact.zhHans: 美达西泮是一种缺少一般羰基氧的苯二氮平类，在体内会转换成地西泮与去甲西泮，它的作用大多由这两者发挥。
